key_points: Ford eliminated supplemental dividends for 2026, signaling cash flow pressure and disappointing income investors
Newport Trust added ~3M shares, showing institutional confidence despite near-term headwinds
Hired former GM executive Marissa West to lead 2029 vehicle refresh, a positive long-term strategic move
Industry-wide affordability crisis with new-vehicle payments at 2023 highs pressures demand outlook
Q3 earnings showed lower revenue and profit YoY but affirmed base dividend; mixed but largely expected
